title: Prime Minister congratulates Parmod on winning Silver at the Asian Para Games
body_text: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today congratulated Parmod on winning Silver in the Men’s 1500m T46 event at the Asian Para Games. Shri Modi stated that repeating his silver-medal finish from the previous edition is a fine achievement, expressing hope that he continues to excel and inspire others through his sporting journey. In a post on X, the Prime Minister's Office shared: "Congratulations to Parmod on winning Silver in the Men’s 1500m T46 event at the Asian Para Games! Repeating his silver-medal finish from the previous edition is a fine achievement. May he continue to excel and inspire others through his sporting journey: PM @narendramodi" Congratulations to Parmod on winning Silver in the Men’s 1500m T46 event at the Asian Para Games!
